limitations: All scores are provisional browser assessments; supplied runtime claims are credited as reported evidence, not independently rerun.
Each entry groups its corresponding normal, enlarged, transition and named state variants; findings assess the weakest material represented variant.
A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces; F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility; overall is 0.4A + 0.6F, normalized for null dimensions and rounded to one decimal.
The authorized threshold is not met: multiple screens and components have A or F below 9.
No conclusive hard-gate failure is established by this deck; viewport cropping alone does not establish unreachable content, and runtime reports scrolling and complete draft retention.
Static transition frames support visual continuity but cannot independently establish motion comfort, timing or responsive interaction.
Physical iPhone, native keyboard, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, haptics, native motion, OS sharing and real payments remain unverified; these browser scores do not certify native 9/10.
Circles demonstrates offline recovery only; authenticated social behavior is unverified.
Speech and invitation sharing include mocked boundaries, reminders use an explicit web preview, and billing is simulated.
Synthetic long-form content and layout predictions establish layout stress coverage, not production-copy defects or predictive quality.
The initial Share performance failure remains material evidence despite the successful unchanged-code isolated recheck; its root cause is unconfirmed.
Removal confirmations, individual memory-edit forms, successful voice transcription, real purchase failures and intermediate city-lookup failure visuals are not fully represented.
topFixes: Stack the share preview, action and export status at 200% to eliminate the narrow, fragmented status column.
Add section navigation to long reading details and simplify the preserved-explanation notice.
Make long invitation/reminder notices visibly scrollable and replace the raw URL presentation with a named copyable link.
Improve enlarged editor scroll-position cues where partially clipped lines obscure orientation.
Explain unsuccessful omen attempts directly and distinguish check-in reminders from forecast deadlines.
Shorten oversized secondary headings and reduce prominent mist behind forms while preserving enlarged text and the hero orb.
